summary: 2024 model is planar. The active interior of its three-state growing-membrane predecessor has monotone thickness; the source already discusses possible transient chaos and reports a limited negative sensitivity test.

model_2024.physical_active_domain: 0<c<1, p>0, M>0, N>0; fixed membrane thickness and flow areas. The reduction assumes osmotic pressure much greater than internal pressure.
model_2024.energy_source: Concentration and osmotic pressure gradients treated as fixed during the modeled interval; no extra reservoir dynamics supplied.

derived_linearization.scope: Linear instability only; no nonlinear Hopf type/stability claim.

model_2024.exclusion: A smooth autonomous planar interior cannot support a regular bounded strange attractor on a compact interior set. Above blockage, c is fixed and pressure grows at N. No reset or smoothing has been added.
model_2024.source_control: Source Figure 3 maps stable, oscillatory, explosive regimes. No periodic-control integration is warranted for this chaos-screening exclusion.

dimensional_equations.K: M_source*R/rho_s > 0; dimensional source prefactor, not the 2024 dimensionless M

growing_predecessor_2019.exclusion_scope: No compact invariant recurrent dynamics wholly in a strict active physical interior; the positive derivative has a positive minimum on a compact interior set and contradicts bounded L_m.
growing_predecessor_2019.boundary_limitations: No global theorem for arbitrary boundary extensions, dissolution, repair, or external forcing. A full source implementation was not reconstructed.

source_own_transient_chaos_discussion.reported_result: No difference in explosion time; experimental spread attributed as likely stochastic. This is limited numerical evidence, not a rigorous exclusion of all transient chaos.

growing_predecessor_2019.supplement_status: Publisher lists anie201812331-sup-0001-misc_information.pdf; HTTP403 on public download. Institutional original bundle contains main manuscript only. Growth-dependent permeability law and complete numerical parameter table not independently verified.

sources.full_text_access: EuropePMC XML HTTP500; full text not independently recovered in this audit

literature_scope: Exact title/DOI/chaos searches plus primary lineage and bounded forward title/DOI screening. Not a full-text audit of all later citing works; no proof of absence or novelty.
